nodes.title: Whiteboard gate W9 no_reveal (wb-gate@2): nothing drawn equals a kit item's answer (rational equality; drawn/derived numbers, column/fraction/equation results, non-axis number-line ticks, a dot/arrow/leader at the answer's position, the asked item's word answer) unless she says it in the line; every item withheld (StudioAsk has no asked ledger); kitNumbers drops item answers; WB_SYSTEM ends with a setup-only shape note for question lines; a W9 repair is told what to remove

planWhiteboard calls on quotaLane hot (W2-E patch applied), WB_MAX_TOKENS 1100 (measured out p90 375, max 659), repair only with >= 3 s of the 7 s budget left, 4-16 ops; lanes.js TPM gains taxila-gpt6 / -gpt6-luna / -gpt61-sol at 500k

routes.json drops the opportunistic taxila-gpt6-luna race arm (defaults + 12 archetypes): that deployment carries the per-line live whiteboard; deviation from MODEL-ROUTER §0 (measured arm gain 14/15 -> 15/15, CIs overlap); restore when a dedicated STUDIO_WB_DEPLOY exists

Router rule 2: the whiteboard is allowed at bond stage meeting (not a build: no code, no interaction, a gated script our code draws) but refused under parent control ready_made (studio.ready_made_only); seam.requestIntent asks routerDecide

planWhiteboard returns usd (sum of usdOf over every round); the seam books breaker.spend for every board and writes ONE studio_mount row per whiteboard beat (its first board), later continue boards add their usd to that row

clock.ts awaitLineAnchor takes the anchor of EXACTLY the script's line (same teacherReplySeq) at any age, so a late script is drawn on her clock (catch-up, not a replay after her line); AnchorTiming {lateMs, source} is posted to POST /api/studio/wb-timing (seam noteWbTiming / wbTimingStats) as the production sync telemetry

W6 duration and clause onsets estimated from toSpoken(text) (spoken.js), not digits; W4 reads number words past twelve both languages (comprehension phrase reader per clause, translit Roman Hindi 0-99, 'teen bata aath' = 3/8); a placeholder (1/?, 3/__) counts only its digits
plan.js sectorsForCutCircles: a circle cut by k diameters (2k parts) or k radii (k parts) through its centre becomes N exact equal sectors when N is a count her line gives; shape only, never truth

chatStream attaches err.diag (status, url, redirected, type, whitelisted headers, ms) and logs one line on empty_stream; the streaming-client test stamps a nonce header and prints the diag; no retry; root cause of the full-suite flake unconfirmed (did not reproduce 2026-10-05)
Deviation recorded for the main loop: the router bench cannot reproduce LIVE-STUDIO §14 numbers (portrait 360x640 probe vs the 360x320 tray), the earlier 'Deviations: none' was wrong

whiteboard-bench luna-none n=31 (30 production lines + pizza), production 7 s budget, hot lane, W9 on: 27/31 drawn (20 first try), p50 2695 / p90 3912 ms, out tokens p90 375 max 659, $0.00022/line; estimated lateness after audio start p50 1995 / p90 3212 ms (bar p90 <= 1500 NOT met); before the W9 repair hint 22/31 with 5 W9 refusals, all true reveals on question lines
ARM listing: taxila-gpt6, taxila-gpt6-luna, taxila-gpt61-sol GlobalStandard 500k TPM each; gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol quota 1000/2000 used

tests/prod/w2f-studio-gate.mjs part B locally (Neon test branch, 4 lessons, accounts 4 -> 4): after fixing the test's {slot} unwrap bug, 3 boards reached the client, each re-passes W0-W9 with the kit, arrival 1.7-2.7 s after the reply (<= 6 s); 1 more board refused by W9 in the server log; sync estimate p50 1824 / p90 2026 ms FAILS the 1500 ms bar (n=3); 19/20 checks
Exempting answer values that the item's prompt shows from W9 withholding broke 'Mark 7 on the number line' (the marked 7 IS the answer); replaced by: values she says in the line are hers to draw
The sandbox-proxy explanation of the empty_stream full-suite flake: NO_PROXY already covers 127.0.0.1 and the review's run failed after the noProxy dispatcher; replaced by diagnostics
A retry on a 200 with no events: hides a real production failure mode (a cut stream looks like a slow success; races mis-measure)
